column11: especially in the latter part of the game.  I tried to leave at 10 or above and sometimes 20.  I never left before 50.
column13: surprise_desc:Several times.  I concentrated on digging fast and leaving when I \felt\ I needed to cut my losses vs. time it took to travel to a new planet.  I counted roughly in my head.
column17: other_desc:My strategy was intuitive. I did not \think\ that much but rather concentrated on the moment of digging and kept a rough track of amounts per planet landing in my head. I just mainly though stayed focused on beiing fast. I did not stay long during the breaks as I knew there was a set amount of time to dig
column20: feedback:Fun experience.  Enjoyed seeing the aliens and loved the sound of metal hitting on the digs. }
